observation.summary: huntPlan treats every route other than forage as mission, so corrupted or unknown route state silently selects a different hunt.

evidence.statement: Only route === 'forage' branches; all other values return a mission plan without validation.

hypothesis.cause: Route validation is implicit instead of fail-closed at the canonical plan boundary.
hypothesis.prediction: Explicit mission/forage validation rejects unknown routes while preserving all valid mission and forage outcomes.
hypothesis.falsifier: Valid route behavior changes or an unknown route still produces a plan.

candidates.reason: Small pure boundary guard before plan selection.
Would leave the canonical planner permissive and duplicate validation.

implementation.summary: Reject unknown hunt routes at the canonical plan boundary and assert within an existing native-loop test case.

before.summary: unknown route silently returns mission plan.

limitations: No browser or full combat-duration claim.

next: Inspect a separate native hunt invariant after merge.
